fields.mechanism: Proton transport through intermediate-temperature proton-conducting electrolytes
fields.intervention: Integrate a thin-film proton-conducting ceramic layer (e.g., doped BaZrO3) into the seal interface to facilitate controlled proton migration and prevent hydride-induced lattice expansion that causes embrittlement.
fields.expected_effect: Mitigation of seal embrittlement by managing hydrogen species transport at the molecular level without external heating, maintaining zero-leak integrity at 70MPa and -40C.
fields.falsification_test: Subject the modified coupling to rapid cycling between ambient and -40C at 70MPa hydrogen pressure; failure is confirmed if seal leakage exceeds 1x10^-6 mbar·L/s or if post-test microscopy reveals intergranular cracking characteristic of embrittlement.
